_note: Wings welded into base_link. The classifier reads anything flat and spanwise as a tail, which puts the ailerons and flaps in the wrong place - they sit on the wing and go with it. The rudder and elevator are genuinely tail and stay.

wing.comment: Measured with scripts/measure-band.py. The fore/aft band already kept the tailplane out; the vertical band is what keeps the main gear legs out, and tightening the fore/aft band to what is actually at wing height drops 318 of the 732 vertices outboard of the fuselage that the old box was taking.
